{{Quote|A contest to see which talentless young boob can make a prettier holo than the other, or some such nonsense. Modern art, bah! Can't stand any of it. This Arts Gala is all a sham. So were you going to do this for me or not?|Sidoras Bey|<ref name="AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Sidoras Bey''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He once was a [[Sculptor/Legends|sculptor]], and a [[Grunda Painting|portrait]] made by [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Artist/Legends|artist]] [[Odoof Grunda]] depicted him sculpting a statue of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Bey tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with a number of assignments, including rescuing a child of his named [[Silaras Bey]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Sidoras Bey was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
